text:
fran: Heads-up 1 PR ready for final: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs/pull/8011. It's a migration + SDK snippet cleanup. Can legal + security take a look at the SDK examples and the migration notes that mention customer audit logs?

mike: I ran linkcheck in CI and it's failing on two external links in the migration guide (old partner blog). Also one example in Python left an env var set to `os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY']='sk_live_ABC123'` 1 we need to remove real-ish tokens before merge.

zara: @mike please replace with `os.environ['REDWOOD_API_KEY'] = 'YOUR_API_KEY'` and add a short KMS note. I'll patch if you want.

legal-team: We'll review. Quick ask: any exported screenshots with redacted metadata? If you captured logs that contain customer IDs, we need a redaction request.

fran: There is one screenshot of the console showing a request id - it's not a real customer id but looks similar. I'll redact before merging.

sec: Also flagging that the migration guide references an internal S3 bucket path `s3://redwood-internal/audit` 1 that needs to be replaced with `s3://<your-audit-bucket>` and we should add a note about IAM least-privilege.

docs-bot: preview build queued for PR #8011 1 status: queued. Linkcheck step scheduled.

mike: Pushed commit 12c9d to sanitize snippets and swap bucket placeholders. Removed screenshot and attached a generic flow diagram instead.

docs-bot: preview started for commit 12c9d 1 status: running (link-check in progress).

zara: @legal-team when you post your wording, can you include the exact retention window phrasing? CS asks for "retain X days" language so we can surface it in the migration checklist.

legal-team: Sure. Suggested wording: "We collect request metadata (request id, timestamps, error codes) for operational diagnostics and retain this data for 90 days by default. For enterprise customers, retention can be configured via the Private deployment settings; contact support for custom SLAs." Use that verbatim and include a footer line: "Legal reviewed: 2026-03-20" in the PR.

sec: LGTM on content. One security nit: do not show example role ARNs that map to internal accounts. Replace with `arn:aws:iam::YOUR_ACCOUNT_ID:role/RedwoodDocsRole`.

mike: Fixed role ARN + updated Python snippet to use placeholder. Pushed commit 12c9d2.

docs-bot: preview re-run for commit 12c9d2 1 status: warnings (accessibility) 1 missing alt text on one SVG. Preview: https://preview.redwood.ai/ci/8011/preview

fran: I'll add alt text in the diagram. Also scheduling note: please avoid merging during today's deploy freeze window 09:30-10:30 PT. Can we aim for merge at 11:15 PT after canary?

deploy-bot: Canary publish can be scheduled once preview passes. I will not run canary during freeze windows.

cs: Heads up, include a short “customer impact” bullet in the PR description so CS can triage post-publish.

zara: Added alt text + CS impact bullets, updated PR description.

docs-bot: preview completed 1 status: pass (link-check + a11y fixes needed addressed). Logs: https://preview.redwood.ai/ci/8011/logs

fran: Everything green. Legal tag added to PR description. I'll schedule canary for 11:15 PT and notify @cs for verification.

legal-team: Confirmed wording is in the PR and documented. No further changes from legal.

mike: Approved on GitHub after verifying placeholders and edits.

zara: Approved as well.

fran: Canary started at 11:15 PT. Deploy-bot will report success/failure in this channel.

deploy-bot: Canary publish in staging started. Running smoke checks.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded 1 smoke checks passed. No rollback triggers. Scheduling merge at 11:25 PT.

fran: Merged at 11:26 PT. Added "Legal reviewed: 2026-03-20" to the PR body and left a short redaction note in the SDK guide: "All examples use placeholders; do not embed secrets in docs."

cs: Noted 1 will update the CS KB entry to reflect the telemetry retention language.

legal-team: Marking thread archived for audit; filing the review note in the compliance tracker.

fran: Thanks all 1 short and efficient.
